name: humid_air_1691_whf_drier_than_house_starts
description: Outdoor dew point 58F against a 61F house (outdoor air drier than the house): the fan starts and dries the house
notes: Dew points (feels_like.dew_point_f): indoor 76.0F at 59.8% = 61.01F; outdoor 64.0F at 80.9% = 58.02F. Ceiling = default 65F (option On).

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: a guard reading the absolute dew point alone (58F > 55F) would wrongly block this night. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: ventilation that dries the house keeps running; the person gets free cooling AND drier air.

verdict.summary: Outdoor dew point 58F against a 61F house (outdoor air drier than the house): the fan starts and dries the house

events.note: Summer evening, windows closed: outdoor cooler than the house, so free cooling is on offer by temperature.
Hot day, cool mode: with the windows closed the AC holds the band (no fan starts in a sealed house).
Five minutes later, same air: the engine re-asks the start question (paused-reactivation / idle-open re-check).

assertions.reason: Windows closed: the cool band is armed and the AC holds it.
Outdoor dew point 58F against a 61F house (outdoor air drier than the house): the fan starts and dries the house
Drier outdoor air is let in.
